MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 7
   C. 1
   D. 12

2. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 42

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 27
   C. 17
   D. 25

4. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 81

5. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 122

6. Solve for x: x + 6 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 11
   C. 5
   D. 6

7. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

8. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 33

9. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 15
   C. 56
   D. 1

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

11. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 33

12. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 26

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
